_readme.howToAdd: Copy any object in 'services', give it a unique id + modalId, set 'slider' to 1 or 2, and fill in the fields. Order in this array = order on the page.
_readme.images: Each service keeps its pictures in images/services/<service-title>/ - e.g. Botox uses images/services/botox/. A new service gets a new folder named after its title, lowercased and hyphenated. See images/README.md.
_readme.enabled: Set "enabled": false to hide a service (card + modal) without deleting it. That is the JSON equivalent of commenting the markup out.
_readme.media: modal.media.type is either 'image' (single picture) or 'swiper' (slideshow). For 'swiper', swiperClass must match the class the init script in index.html uses.
_readme.fit: Every modal is the same size and every picture is shown whole, never cropped - set by object-fit-contain in modal.media.imgClass. Swap that one word for object-fit-cover on a single service to make its picture fill the panel edge to edge instead, losing whatever does not fit. Only do that for a plain photo, never for a before/after.
_readme.table: modal.table.position is 'inside' (table sits in the text column, under the description - this is what every service uses) or 'outside' (table sits full width under both columns - not used by anything right now).
_readme.tableCells: A cell is either a plain string, or an object like { "text": "SVR", "rowspan": 8 } for merged cells.

body: Experience the targeted solution for cellulite with Spherofill Cell—a specialized treatment for cellulite circles or dimples. Trust in the expertise of our professionals to provide a tailored plan, allowing you to rediscover smoother, more even skin. Spherofill cell is designed to enhance your confidence and redefine your skin's appearance.
